entry.title: Planning Board: the meeting of 24 August 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Planning Board approved flood-plain and multi-dwelling special permits for three properties; two hearings continued for lack of quorum. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vZDJ6B71qqI), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
